packageRules.description: For any APK package in a Dockerfile, only allow patch and pin updates. This enforces the 'major.minor.x' pinning strategy.
For any Docker FROM image, allow minor and patch updates.
Group all updates by their source Dockerfile to create logical PRs.

The example Go app's go directive is read by the scanner as the Go standard library it was built with, so it names the exact Go that go-base ships and follows its patches. Capped below the next minor: a go 1.27 floor would not build on go-base's Go 1.26. Raise the cap when go-base moves to a new Go line. ignorePaths is the ignoreModulesAndTests list with **/examples/** narrowed so that only examples/go-app is visible: the other examples stay unmanaged, as before.

zizmor-action's version input is a zizmor version, not an image: since action v0.7.0 it installs that exact version's wheel from PyPI against the action's own hash lock. Renovate's built-in mapping reads the input as the ghcr.io/zizmorcore/zizmor container, so docker:pinDigests would write an image digest the action cannot install. Version updates still arrive through that mapping.

zizmor-action only runs zizmor versions it ships a hash lock for and rejects any other with 'Unknown version'. Grouping the action with its version input means a zizmor release that arrives before the action supports it turns only this pull request red, not the shared patch or minor group, and the pull request goes green once the action release carrying that lock joins it.
